description: Per-element parameters for the DFT-D4 dispersion correction (EEQ charge model, D4 coordination number, charge scaling and C8 extrapolation) for Z = 1..36, extracted programmatically from the pinned upstream sources listed in 'fields'. Field names follow the upstream Fortran array names where possible.

mctc-lib.note: pinned by dftd4 subprojects/mctc-lib.wrap; provides the CN kernels

units.eta: chemical hardness, hartree/e^2 (EEQ diagonal); may be negative
units.kcnchi: CN scaling constant of the EEQ electronegativity, hartree/e
units.rad: EEQ charge width / damping radius, bohr
units.chemical_hardness: chemical hardness used by the D4 charge scaling function zeta(ga, eta*gc, q_ref, q), hartree/e^2
units.covalent_rad_2009_angstrom: Pyykko/Atsumi covalent radius in Angstrom exactly as printed upstream (metals already reduced by 10 %); upstream multiplies by aatoau at compile time
units.zeff: effective nuclear charge of the def2 ECP, e (q is shifted by zeff)
units.r4_over_r2: <r^4>/<r^2> expectation value, bohr^2, raw upstream table (r4r2.f90:44-68); NOT the value used in the damping
units.r4r2: derived sqrt(0.5*r4_over_r2*sqrt(Z)) (r4r2.f90:70-71), the value get_r4r2_val returns and D4 uses in C8/C6 = 3*r4r2_i*r4r2_j
